description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget representing a sign-in page. It includes UI components for Google Sign-In, manages loading and error states, and interacts with an authentication repository to perform sign-in actions.

classes.name: SignInPage
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the sign-in interface with a Google Sign-In button.

classes.name: _SignInPageState
classes.description: State class managing the sign-in page's UI state, including loading and error states, and handling the sign-in process.

methods.name: _handleSignIn
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked when the user taps the sign-in button; interacts with the authentication repository to sign in with Google and updates UI state accordingly.
